request: From the Material Certs sheet (Heat No, Supplier, Grade) make a Supplier Grades sheet with one row for each supplier and grade that appear together and the number of certificates, suppliers A to Z. Supplier and grade are matched ignoring case and stray spaces. Rows with no supplier or no grade are ignored. The sheet is rebuilt every run.

Check the Dispatch sheet (Dispatch No, Job ID, Planned Date, Job Check) against the Job Tracker (Job ID, Customer, Status). In the Dispatch sheet write Unknown job in Job Check when the Job ID is not in the Job Tracker, Job closed when that job's Status is Closed, and clear it on the others. Job IDs differ in case and stray spaces. Add the heading if it's missing, and tell me how many need a look.

In the NDE Report (Weld Seam No, Method, Result, Report Date) colour the whole row red when the Result is Reject and yellow when the Result is Pending and the Report Date is more than 3 days ago. Clear old row colours first so it can be run again, and tell me how many rows are red.

In Welder Quals (Welder ID, Process, Expiry Date, Status) write Expired in Status when the Expiry Date is before today, Expires soon when it is in the next 30 days, Valid otherwise, and No date when there is no Expiry Date. Tell me how many are Expired or Expires soon.

In the WPS Register (WPS No, Process, Thickness Min, Thickness Max, Remark) write Check range in Remark when Thickness Max is more than ten times Thickness Min, and clear it on the others. Rows where either thickness is blank, zero or not a number are left alone. The thicknesses are sometimes typed as text. Tell me how many I marked.

In the Weld Log (Weld Seam No, Visual, NDE Required, NDE Result, Remark) write NDE pending in Remark for every weld whose Visual is Accepted, NDE Required is Yes and NDE Result is blank, and clear the Remark on the others. Yes and Accepted are typed in any case. Tell me how many are pending.

From the Weld Log (Weld Seam No, Welder ID, Visual) make a Welder Visual sheet with each Welder ID, how many welds they made and how many were not Accepted, the most welds first. Welder IDs are typed with stray spaces; rows with no Welder ID are ignored. The sheet is rebuilt every run.

From the WPS Register (WPS No, Process, PQR Ref) make a WPS by Process sheet with each Process, its number of WPS and how many of them have no PQR Ref, processes A to Z, and a last row Total with the two sums. Processes are typed in mixed case. The sheet is rebuilt every run.

From the BOM (Part No, Material Grade, Required Qty) make a Grade Totals sheet with each Material Grade and its total Required Qty, the biggest first. Grades are typed with stray spaces and in mixed case; rows with no grade are ignored and a Required Qty that is not a number is left out. The sheet is rebuilt every run.

From the NDE Report (Weld Seam No, Inspector, Result) make an Inspector Summary sheet with each Inspector, how many reports they signed, and how many of those are Reject, inspectors A to Z. Rows with no Inspector are ignored. The sheet is rebuilt every run.

Check the Weld Log (Weld Seam No, Welder ID, Process, Qual Check) against Welder Quals (Welder ID, Process, Expiry Date). In the Weld Log write No qual in Qual Check when the welder has no qualification for that process, and clear it on the others. Welder IDs and processes differ in case and stray spaces. Add the heading if it's missing, and tell me how many welds have no qual.

Check the ITP Tracker (ITP No, Point, Inspection Status, NCR Hold) against the NCR Register (NCR No, ITP No, Status). In the ITP Tracker write Hold in NCR Hold for every point whose ITP No has at least one NCR that is not Closed, and clear it on the others. ITP numbers differ in case and stray spaces. Tell me how many points are on hold.

In the Weld Log (Weld Seam No, Welder ID, Visual) make every Weld Seam No and Welder ID trimmed and upper case, with any run of spaces inside made one space. Leave blank cells alone, change no other column, and tell me how many cells I changed.

In the BOM (Part No, Description, Unit) make the Unit cells consistent: kg, Kg and kgs become KG; nos, no and pcs become NOS; mtr, m and meter become MTR (any case, stray spaces). Leave other units and blank cells alone, and tell me how many cells I changed.

On an Expired Batches sheet list every batch of the Consumable Stock sheet (Batch No, Filler Class, Qty On Hand, Expiry Date) whose Expiry Date is before today, with the same headings, the oldest first. Batches with no Expiry Date are skipped. The sheet is rebuilt every run.

For every Welder ID in Welder Quals (Welder ID, Process, Folder Status) make a folder named after the Welder ID inside the Welder Certs folder (a folder path I give the macro). A welder listed on several rows gets one folder. Write Made, Already there or Bad name in Folder Status on every row. Never delete or overwrite anything.
In the BOM (Part No, Required Qty, Issued Qty, Short Qty) put a formula in Short Qty for every data row: Required Qty minus Issued Qty when that is more than zero, otherwise 0. Excel 2016 only.

On the Weld Log (Weld Seam No, Welder ID, Visual) show only the rows of the Welder ID I give the macro (any case, stray spaces) and hide the others. Tell me how many rows are visible below the headings.

A filler traceability tool, started with one macro. (1) In the Weld Log (Weld Seam No, Weld Date, Batch No, Remark) write Unknown batch in Remark when the Batch No is not in the Consumable Stock sheet (Batch No, Filler Class, Expiry Date), Expired batch when that batch expired before the Weld Date, and clear Remark on the others. (2) On a Batch Usage sheet write each Batch No used in the Weld Log with its number of welds, the most first. (3) On a Weld Problems sheet list the welds that got a remark, with the same headings. (4) Tell me how many welds have a remark. Batch numbers differ in case and stray spaces. The output sheets are rebuilt every run. Each numbered step should also be a macro I can run on its own.

A weekly inspection tool, started with one macro. (1) In the ITP Tracker (ITP No, Point, Weld Seam No, Inspection Status, Flag) write NDE reject in Flag for every point whose Weld Seam No has a Reject in the NDE Report (Weld Seam No, Result), Open NCR when its ITP No has an NCR that is not Closed in the NCR Register (NCR No, ITP No, Status), and clear Flag on the others; NDE reject wins when both apply. (2) On a Flagged Points sheet list the flagged points with the same headings, ITP No A to Z. (3) On an NCR Count sheet write each ITP No with its number of NCRs that are not Closed, the most first. (4) Tell me how many points I flagged. The output sheets are rebuilt every run. Each numbered step should also be a macro I can run on its own.

A welder qualification audit, started with one macro. (1) In Welder Quals (Welder ID, Process, Expiry Date, Remark) write Expired in Remark where the qualification has expired, Expires soon where it expires in the next 30 days, and clear it on the others. (2) In the Weld Log (Weld Seam No, Welder ID, Process, Weld Date, Qual Check) write Not qualified in Qual Check when the welder has no qualification for that process that was still valid on the Weld Date, and clear it on the others. (3) On a Welder Problems sheet write each Welder ID with its number of Not qualified welds, the most first. (4) Tell me how many welds are Not qualified. IDs and processes differ in case and stray spaces. The output sheet is rebuilt every run. Each numbered step should also be a macro I can run on its own.

A receiving tool, started with one macro. (1) In the GRN (GRN No, Part No, Heat No, Received Qty, Remark) write No cert in Remark when the Heat No has no row in Material Certs (Heat No, MTC No), Check when the Received Qty is not a positive number, and clear Remark on the others. (2) In the BOM (Part No, Required Qty, Received, Status) write in Received the total received for each part over all GRN lines, and in Status Complete when that is at least Required Qty and Short otherwise. (3) On a Short Parts sheet list the Short BOM lines with the same headings, Part No A to Z. (4) Tell me how many parts are Short. Part and heat numbers differ in case and stray spaces. The output sheet is rebuilt every run. Each numbered step should also be a macro I can run on its own.

A procedure coverage tool, started with one macro. (1) In the WPS Register (WPS No, Process, PQR Ref, Remark) write No PQR in Remark when PQR Ref is blank or not in the PQR List (PQR No, Process, Result), PQR failed when that PQR's Result is Fail, and clear Remark on the others. (2) In Welder Quals (Welder ID, Process, WPS Check) write No WPS in WPS Check when the welder's process has no WPS without a remark, and clear it on the others. (3) On a Process Coverage sheet write each process in the WPS Register with its number of WPS, of WPS with a remark and of welders qualified for it, processes A to Z. (4) Tell me how many welder rows have No WPS. The output sheet is rebuilt every run. Each numbered step should also be a macro I can run on its own.

An instrument control tool, started with one macro. (1) In the Calibration Tracker (Instrument ID, Type, Next Calibration Due, Status) write Overdue in Status when the instrument is overdue, Due soon when it is due in the next 14 days, and OK otherwise; No date when there is no due date. (2) In the ITP Tracker (ITP No, Point, Instrument ID, Inspection Status, Cal Flag) write Out of cal in Cal Flag for every point that is not Closed and uses an Overdue instrument, Unknown instrument when the instrument isn't in the Calibration Tracker, and clear it on the others. (3) On an Instruments To Calibrate sheet list the Overdue and Due soon instruments with the same headings, the earliest due date first. (4) Tell me how many points are Out of cal. Instrument IDs differ in case and stray spaces. The output sheet is rebuilt every run. Each numbered step should also be a macro I can run on its own.

In the PQR List (PQR No, Process, Test Date, Result, Remark) write Retest due in Remark for every PQR whose Result is Fail and whose Test Date is more than 90 days ago, and clear the Remark on the others. Fail is typed in any case; a PQR with no real Test Date is left alone. Tell me how many retests are due.

On a Welder List sheet list every row of Welder Quals (Welder ID, Process, Expiry Date) for the process I give the macro (any case, stray spaces), with the same headings, Welder IDs A to Z. The sheet is rebuilt every run.

A weld NDE follow-up tool, started with one macro. (1) In the Weld Log (Weld Seam No, Welder ID, NDE Status) write Rejected in NDE Status when the NDE Report (Weld Seam No, Method, Result) has a Reject for that seam, Accepted when it has rows and none is Reject, and Not tested when it has none. (2) On a Repair List sheet list the Rejected welds with the same headings, Weld Seam No A to Z. (3) On a Welder Rejects sheet write each Welder ID with its number of Rejected welds, the most first. (4) Tell me how many welds are Not tested. Seam numbers differ in case and stray spaces. The output sheets are rebuilt every run. Each numbered step should also be a macro I can run on its own.
